clips.title: The story
paras: Sully Balloo's Letter is a waterlogged, tender missive recovered from the sunken remains of a dwarven soldier beneath the Thandol Span. Addressed to his wife Sara in Ironforge, it represents the quiet personal tragedies lingering beneath the grand conflicts of Khaz Modan.

Beneath the massive stone pillars of the Thandol Span, connecting the Wetlands to the Arathi Highlands, lies the skeletal remains of a dwarf pinned deep under the rushing water. Clutched in his grasp is a fragile, waterlogged envelope containing this letter. Written with painstaking care in his final days or hours, it begins with the poignant words, 'My dear Sara....' Though the parchment has suffered from prolonged submersion, the ink still holds the enduring love of a dwarven defender who never made it back home to the city of Ironforge.
